notes.title: Quests Unleashed & Dungeon Arena Rising
notes.content:
Prepare for the dungeons! 🏰 While we've been toiling away on these epic adventures, they're still under wraps for a grand reveal when they're truly ready for action! Stay tuned!

This week, our team has been on fire, expanding the quest framework and crafting a formidable dungeon arena for you to conquer! 🔥🏹🏰 

[b]Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Extra Quests: Added new quests to enhance your gaming experience.

[*] Dungeon Level Spawner & Manager: Introduced systems to handle dungeon level spawning.

notes.title: Performance Boost & Food Economy
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Treasure Chest Fixes[/b]: We've resolved errors related to treasure chests for seamless loot collection.

notes.title: Starhaven: A New Chapter
notes.content:
This update brings a wealth of new content to The Shrouded Parchments, including:

New quests: Help Agnes the Herbalist gather flowers, or explore the ghost village and battle its undead inhabitants.

[list]
[*] Explore the updated Ghost Village area
[*] Pick flowers and complete quests
[*] Bug fixes and quality of life improvements
[*] New HUD graphics
[*] Zoom functionality
[*] Auto pickup toggle
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Here are some additional details about the update:
[list]
[*] The Ghost Village area is now home to the rare ghost bloom flowers. These flowers can be picked up and used to complete the quests for Agnes. But beware the ghosts guarding them.
[*] There are also a few new quests that have been added to the game. These quests involve picking flowers, defeating enemies, and exploring the Ghost Village.
[*] New items: Complete quests and receive the new Nature Staff as a reward and call the stars to help you in battle.
[*] The update also includes a number of bug fixes and quality of life improvements. For example, the HUD graphics have been updated.
[*] There is now a zoom functionality.
[*] Finally, the update includes an auto pickup toggle. This means that you can now choose whether or not to automatically pick up items when you walk over them, the only caveat is that it will not work on environment pickups (flowers, rocks, wood, etc. > eg. pickups you get through exploring)
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this new update to The Shrouded Parchments!

notes.title: A New Path to Power: Crafting System
notes.content:
Added Crafting System

We're excited to announce the addition of a crafting system to the Shrouded Parchments! This new system allows you to create potions using the drops from goblin and undead enemies, as well as the mushrooms that you can find in the area just outside the starting castle. All of the ingredients for these potions can be found in this area, so you won't have to go far to start crafting.

The only crafting table available at the moment is located inside the academy, in the main hall. However, we plan to add more crafting tables in the future, so you'll be able to craft potions from anywhere in the world.

We're also very excited to begin working on adding more weapons, weapon types, crafting receipes and enemies to the existing areas. We'll keep you updated on our progress, and we can't wait to see what you create!
